target: For EVERY odd prime p>=7 and EVERY actual D_(2p) word with R=p+1 rotations and F=3p-2 reflections, prove an original-order identity selection of exactly2p positions. Values, rotation-gap multiplicities, raw matching numbers and all order/type data are unrestricted. This includes the full literal lower residual at all its retained caller/import boundaries.
new_mechanism: Fix an EVEN actual rotation subset K, and parameterize only the reflection selection by cyclic Boolean gap colours. Its coordinate V_K is affine linear in the colours; its size Z_K is quadratic. At F=3p-2, the full-colour coefficient of the Fermat indicator is the coefficient of L_K^(p-1) Z_2^(p-1). The highest-colour coefficient ignores rotation contributions in the initial colour-zero gap. Use one named actual rotation there solely to fix rotation-count parity; the other p named rotation statuses give a polynomial of degree<=p-1 on a p-dimensional Boolean box. Hypothetical absence of identity2p forces that polynomial to be the point mass at the empty subset, contradicting signed-box cancellation.
